snippet.title: No More Furries | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Hordes of Werewolves siege the world and you alone must find out how to stop it. 

Fight in a Singleplayer Round-Based Survival Shooter, as you fight off waves of enemies. Only the Strongest can survive the longest in this action packed game. 

Discover New weapons, maps, and more as the fight continues on. This game is made with a few indie devs and content releases will come with each Furry-Lycan Filled update! 

► WISHLIST
